description: Mesoscope column (panels B, F, J) of the cross-modality unit-extraction figure. The panels and the stacked composite are both produced offline by the renderer scripts below and committed under figure_sources/media; openscope_p3_publication.figures.write_unit_extraction_mesoscope_svg only wraps the committed composite in SVG, so the build re-encodes no image bytes and its output is identical on every platform.

cohort.class_fit: k-means (k = 3) on the standardised (<2, 2-4, >4 SD) event-amplitude fractions, fitted once over the whole cohort and ordered by the centroid's >4 SD fraction
cohort.omission_reason: no resolvable processed-asset path in the session inventory

source_table.name: mesoscope_roi_metrics_cohort81.csv.gz
source_table.note: not committed: 37 MB per-ROI table produced on the analysis cluster; the checksum pins the table the panels were rendered from

note: The renderer scripts need scipy, which is not a repo dependency, and the uncommitted per-ROI cohort table; they are committed as the record of how the panel PNGs were produced, not as part of the figure build.
